name: DonutSMP
description:
DonutSMP is one of the largest and most popular Minecraft Bedrock servers, a crossplay network with Skyblock, Prison, Factions and Survival for Bedrock and Java players. Free to play.

Bedrock Server IP: DonutSMP.net

Bedrock Server Port: 19132

Java Server IP: DonutSMP.net

Versions: the latest Bedrock and Java 1.8 to the latest (latest recommended). Play on mobile (MCPE), Windows, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch, with full crossplay with Java players. No mods or add-ons needed.

DonutSMP Server in numbers:

- Online since 2017, 9 years running

- 15,000+ players online at once every day, with peaks near 48,000

- 1,000,000+ Discord members

- 10+ votes on minecraft-server-list.com, #200+ ranking

Minecraft Bedrock Skyblock Server: The DonutSMP Skyblock server is a Bedrock and Java crossplay Skyblock server with seasonal island resets, island teams of up to 10, custom enchants and runes, minions, Island Top competitions with store credit prizes for the top 10 islands every month, and the Pharaoh's Tomb PvE area.

Minecraft Bedrock Prison Server: The DonutSMP Prison server is a Bedrock and Java prison server with 38 mines: 26 rank mines from A to Z plus 12 prestige mines. Prestige is unlimited, and every prestige gives crate keys, tags and more mana and unlocks new enchant upgrades and perks, with a new mine at each prestige up to 12. Upgrade your pickaxe with tokens through a full skill tree, hot streaks and the Momentum mining style, add runes at the infuser, and fill your backpack. Team up in gangs and compete on Gang Top, use nukes, fight in the PvP Arena with envoys and events, and grind the Skull Island PvE zone for tokens, treasure keys and boss loot. Keep inventory is on everywhere except contraband PvE loot.
